calling_convention.source: revealed by executing jda sqt via SIMH pdp1 (open-simh V4.1-0); confirmed by pdp1_cpu.c case 007
calling_convention.jda_Y: M[Y] ← AC (input); AC ← PC (return address); PC ← Y+1
calling_convention.sqt_entry_flow: jda sqt → M[0246]=input, AC=return_PC, PC=0247; then: dap sqx patches sqx with return_PC; lio sqt loads input into IO; dzm sqt clears M[0246]; algorithm runs; lac sq2 puts result in AC; sqx: jmp <return_PC>
calling_convention.input_format: 18-bit integer in AC, binary point right of bit 17 (pure integer)
calling_convention.output_format: 9.9 fixed-point in AC: integer part in bits 0-8, fractional part in bits 9-17

calibration.halt_pc_note: SIMH increments PC during fetch; hlt is at 07703, PC=07704 after halt

three_way_confluence.masswerk_format_check: integer part = AC >> 9 = 2; fractional part = AC & 0777 = 0; consistent with Translator: 'answer in ac with binary point between bits 8 and 9'
